Subject: Retailorama intro — they asked for an eval/demo

Hey team,

Quick intro — Retailorama (Tanya Holt, Director of Product) is evaluating vector search + summarization flows for customer support triage. We worked with them on a POC for search earlier this year and they specifically asked for a demo focused on latency/cost tradeoffs and private deployment options.

Tanya asked if we could connect them with someone who can walk through Redwood’s hosted + dedicated routing and show cost/sla options. I think Marissa is a great fit to run the demo; Ben for pricing and Priyom for deployment questions.

Tanya contact: Tanya Holt <tholt@retailorama.com>
Notes: mid-market retailer, wants secure SSO and audit logs, procurement window late Nov.

Can Marissa take this? Thanks — appreciate the quick help.

— Alex

Vivek here — looping you in, Marissa and team. I can join the call; happy to provide context on the SI relationship. Please reach out to Tanya directly to lock time.

— Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Intro from BluePeak — quick demo to review fit?

Hi Tanya —

Thanks for the intro, Alex and Vivek. Tanya, great to meet you — I’m Marissa on the Redwood sales team. Ben (pricing) and Priyom (deployment lead) are cc’d.

We’d love to set up a 30-minute demo to:
- Walk through Redwood’s hosted vs dedicated options for low-latency retrieval + summarization
- Show a short cost comparison and expected throughput for your traffic profile
- Cover SSO/KMS and audit log capabilities for procurement

Are you available for a 30-minute slot on either of these days (PT):
- Mon 11/16, 11:00–11:30am PT
- Mon 11/16, 2:00–2:30pm PT
- Wed 11/18, 10:00–10:30am PT

If those don’t work I can send a calendar invite with alternate times. I’ve attached a short demo deck so you have context before the call.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (overview + example flows)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for LLMs

Thanks for reaching out and for the deck — helpful. I can do 11/16 but only late-morning PT; 11:00–11:30 PT on 11/16 works. If Ben/Priyom prefer an earlier slot, I could also do 11/18 at 10:00am PT.

A couple of things to flag so you can tailor the demo:
- We’re sensitive to per-request latency for live chat triage (P95 target < 400ms)
- We have a strict vendor data retention policy and need details on audit logs
- Procurement will want an estimated first-year cost for ~20M tokens/month

Happy to include our infrastructure lead if you want more technical detail — cc’d Alex from BluePeak here.

Thanks,
